claims.claim: Upgrade your sewing and embroidery projects with this Brother SE630 Computerized Sewing and...
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a Brother sewing machine with a blue-lit display area, but the exact model number (SE630) is not readable.
“brother” branding is visible on the machine body in photo 0 and photo 1.

risks.risk: Exact model may not be SE630 (model number not readable), which affects value and compatibility of parts/embroidery features.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model label/plate showing “SE630” (or the exact model number) and the front panel model text.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic Brother computerized sewing machine (worst-case: lower-spec than SE630) with unknown embroidery capability.

risks.risk: Not confirmed working: computerized display may be dead, motor may be weak, or speed control may fail.
risks.proof: A short video of power-on showing the display working, then a stitching test on fabric (forward/reverse and speed control).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/possibly non-working until a stitching test is shown.

risks.risk: Missing or incomplete accessories (presser feet, bobbins, needles, power cord, manual) can reduce usability and increase buyer cost.
risks.proof: A laid-out photo/video of all included accessories: power cord, foot pedal, presser feet set, bobbins, needles, and any manual/adapter.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming accessories are incomplete/unknown and may need replacement.

risks.risk: Cosmetic/functional wear (scratches, rust, worn moving parts, belt/gear issues) may indicate higher repair risk.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the needle area, feed dogs, underside/belt/gear access (if safe), and any visible wear points.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst visible condition (unknown wear) and treat as higher-maintenance until inspected.

risks.risk: Power/voltage mismatch or missing correct adapter for Lagos use could prevent safe operation.
risks.proof: Photo of the power rating label (voltage/Hz) and confirmation of the exact power cord/adapter included.
risks.if_unproven: Price as requiring verification of correct power setup (worst-case: may need an adapter/repair).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the machine’s model label/plate showing the exact model number (confirm whether it is SE630).
Video: power-on with the blue display working, then a short stitching test on fabric (show speed control and reverse if available).
Photos/video of all included accessories: power cord, foot pedal, presser feet, bobbins, needles, and any manual/box contents.
Close-up photos of the needle/foot area and any visible wear (including feed dogs and any accessible underside/gear/belt area).
Photo of the power rating label (voltage/Hz) and confirmation that the included cord/adapter matches Lagos power requirements.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a Brother computerized sewing machine with a visible blue display, but the exact model (SE630) and working condition are not verifiable from the photos. Without a readable model label and a stitching/power test, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
